pages.title: Jellyphants
pages.creator: ShaberCo
pages.description: Send baby elephants to the conveyor in Jellyphants so they can eat the jelly that matches their color. Tap an elephant to dispatch it, and send it back if it returns to the waiting area.

pages.title: Triple Shelf Match
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Move goods between shelves in Triple Shelf Match and clear them in groups of three identical items. Keep a slot open for the next move and use a booster when you run out of room.

pages.title: Obby Prison Run
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Make a break for freedom in Obby Prison Run. Use the keyboard or onscreen buttons to steer, sprint past your rivals, and jump or dodge through traps inspired by playground games.

pages.title: Travel Story Match
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Connect matching travel items in Travel Story Match and use boosters to work through tricky boards. Solving puzzles takes you to new destinations, while daily missions and weekly challenges offer extra goals.

pages.title: FPS Toy Realism
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Fight in teams on the 12-by-12 map in FPS Toy Realism. Choose weapons through the purchase system before battle, then use support items such as medkits and rockets when you need them.

pages.title: Extreme Real Car Driving 2025
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Drive and modify sports cars in Extreme Real Car Driving 2025. Pick a steering control that suits you, then take your garage setup out on the highway. Watch for damage if you make contact at speed.

pages.title: Uno Online
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Empty your hand first in Uno Online. Follow the current card color and keep track of opponents who are close to going out. Use a color change or a draw-two card when it can shift the round.

pages.title: Connect 2 Cars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Connect pairs of cars in Connect 2 Cars. Look for a clear route between matching tiles, then select both to remove them. Clear pairs that open up the center if cars farther in are hard to reach.

pages.title: Merge Hotel Empire
pages.creator: Nova Gaming
pages.description: Merge identical objects in Merge Hotel Empire to create new items. Drag one onto its match and use what you produce to build and decorate the mansion as the hotel story progresses.

pages.title: 2048Skill Edition
pages.creator: Shenzhen haikuo yuntour rede tecnologia co., LTD
pages.description: Aim numbered balls in 2048Skill Edition and shoot them to combine values. Check where the ball will go before releasing it, and use the added skills when a crowded board makes a match difficult.

pages.title: Word Guess Game
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Rearrange scrambled letters in Word Guess Game. Tap them in the order that spells the hidden word. Choose among four modes with words from four to seven letters, each with its own time allowance.

pages.title: Fun Colors
pages.creator: RAD BROTHERS
pages.description: Pick a coloring page or start a drawing in Fun Colors. Try different brushes and shades, upload a picture of your own, or switch to the darker interface when you prefer working in night mode.

pages.title: Ski Jump Challenge
pages.creator: Ringier Axel Springer Polska
pages.description: Control a ski jumper from takeoff through flight in Ski Jump Challenge. Time your movements on the hill and manage the jumper's position in the air as you try to land a longer jump.

pages.title: Trucks Race
pages.creator: DAPALAB
pages.description: Deliver goods by truck in Trucks Race. Hold to drive and release to brake before traffic gets in the way. Earn cash on deliveries to unlock more trucks and discover new highway routes.

pages.title: Agame Stunt Cars
pages.creator: Faramel Games
pages.description: Explore two stunt maps in Agame Stunt Cars. Steer with the arrow keys and line up a car for the jumps you want to try. Use G and H to switch vehicles or M and N to change maps.

pages.title: Edible or not?
pages.creator: FamiGems!
pages.description: Help a hungry monster tell food from other objects in Edible or not? Pick the edible items before they disappear and try to build your score in the time allowed.

pages.title: Climb Racing 3D
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Drive across uneven courses in Climb Racing 3D. Pick a vehicle and collect bonuses as the road changes. Use nitro for speed, the magnet for pickups, or all-wheel drive when the route makes traction important.

pages.title: Red and Blue Ball Cupid love
pages.creator: Bin Studio
pages.description: Control two characters in Red and Blue Ball Cupid love. Use the movement buttons and plan around how each ball responds, so you can get them through the puzzle together and finish the mission.

pages.title: Arabian Princess Dress Up Game
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Style a princess in Arabian Princess Dress Up Game. Try dresses, makeup, and hairstyles, then see how the choices look together. Make a new combination when you want to give the same character a different look.

pages.title: Farmers vs Aliens
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Defend a cow from alien raiders in Farmers vs Aliens. Fire cannons at the attackers and adjust your defense when they change their approach. Keep the cow safe through the assault.

pages.title: Idle Coffee Business
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Turn a small café into a larger operation in Idle Coffee Business. Sell drinks for coins, unlock recipes, and upgrade them to improve earnings. The shop continues generating idle income while you're away.

pages.title: Tallman Run
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Drag side to side in Tallman Run to guide the runner through changes in size. Try to make the runner both taller and wider as you choose a route down the course.

pages.title: Zombie Killer Draw Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Draw an attack route in Zombie Killer Draw Puzzle. Plan a line that reaches every zombie in the room and keeps your fighter clear of danger. Clear all the enemies to get out.

pages.title: Wortsuche Rätsel
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Find the German words listed beside the grid in Wortsuche Rätsel. Read across, down, and diagonally, checking backward as well. Visit the calendar when you want to try a different puzzle.

pages.title: Ellie Fashion Fever
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Give Ellie a new runway look in Ellie Fashion Fever. Browse the wardrobe for each fashion style and choose clothes that fit it. Change her hairstyle to see how it changes the finished look.

pages.title: Solitaire Master-Classic Card
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Sort a standard deck in Solitaire Master-Classic Card. Move cards between columns to uncover hidden ones and build the four suit piles from ace upward. Check what a move reveals before rearranging a stack.

pages.title: Funny Kitty Haircut
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Wash, brush, and color a cat's fur in Funny Kitty Haircut. Use the mouse to style each visitor, then add clothes and accessories that work with the haircut you gave it.

pages.title: Find The Fish
pages.creator: Rich Games
pages.description: Spot the fish pictured in a bubble in Find The Fish and drag the matching one into place. Search without a timer in Fun mode, or try Competitive mode to see how high you can score.

pages.title: Penguin Cookshop
pages.creator: funky forest
pages.description: Run a diner with a family of penguins in Penguin Cookshop. Take orders and serve customers quickly to earn money. Put the proceeds toward upgrades as you work through the levels.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter HD
pages.creator: Azerion Games
pages.description: Aim at groups of matching colors in Bubble Shooter HD. Add your shot to two or more bubbles of the same color to clear them. Look for a placement that can remove a larger section and raise your score.

pages.title: Call of Ops 3
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Compete for the most eliminations in Call of Ops 3. Move around each Deathmatch map with WASD, aim and shoot with the mouse, and change weapons with the number keys.

pages.title: Pool Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Pocket balls to earn stars in Pool Mania. Check the angle from the cue ball to the pocket before taking a shot. Collect enough stars to unlock stronger cues for harder layouts.

pages.title: Rally Point
pages.creator: Xform
pages.description: Race off-road against the clock in Rally Point. Drift through corners and use nitro on stretches where you have room, but watch the heat. Beat the target time to open more cars and tracks.

pages.title: Cup Pong Challenge
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Flick a ping-pong ball into cups in Cup Pong Challenge. Judge the angle and strength before each throw, and try to outlast one of three computer opponents.

pages.title: Block Breaker
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Bounce the ball back into the blocks in Block Breaker. Move with the mouse, arrow keys, or touchscreen and collect power-ups that help clear the board. Break every block to advance.

pages.title: Uphill Cargo Trailer Simulator 2k20
pages.creator: TickTock
pages.description: Drive cargo over rough roads in Uphill Cargo Trailer Simulator 2k20. Give the trailer room to follow on bends and watch your speed on hills as you work through the transport missions.

pages.title: Candy Word
pages.creator: Latimed
pages.description: Match sweets to reveal letters in Candy Word. Move the candies with the mouse or a swipe, then select the uncovered letters to spell a word and earn points.

pages.title: DDTank Tap
pages.creator: will two
pages.description: Use the mouse to play DDTank Tap, a clicker built around the DDTank theme. Click or tap to interact and see how far you can take the session.

pages.title: Cooking In The Kitchen
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Choose a recipe in Cooking In The Kitchen and work through its preparation. Make a pizza or try your hand at a hamburger, following the steps for the dish you select.

pages.title: Sky Knight
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Pilot a fighter through enemy formations in Sky Knight. Use the arrow keys to move and space to fire. Clear the enemies in each stage to continue.

pages.title: Happy Childrens Day 2020 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together six Children's Day illustrations in Happy Childrens Day 2020 Puzzle. Pick a picture and solve it with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces, using color and edges to find the joins.

pages.title: Parkour Run
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Run across rooftops in Parkour Run. Jump through windows, grab ledges, and slide under tanks as the course unfolds. Watch the next obstacle to decide which move will keep the run going.

pages.title: Miss Jenny Jet
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Guide Miss Jenny past obstacles in Miss Jenny Jet. Click to control her flight and adjust her height before she reaches a barrier. Try to make it through each stage without crashing.

pages.title: Tropical Slasher
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Throw a knife through fruit in Tropical Slasher. Time your shot so it cuts the fruit and reaches the trees at the side. Avoid bombs and score as much as you can before time expires.

pages.title: Snake Egg Eater
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Steer a snake toward eggs in Snake Egg Eater. Use the arrows or tap to change direction. The pace increases as you last longer, so decide on your next turn before reaching the egg.

pages.title: Deer Hunter
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Track deer through the forest in Deer Hunter. Move with WASD or the arrows, use the right mouse button to zoom, and fire with the left button once you've lined up the target.

pages.title: Rise Up Xmas
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Drag a candy shield above the snowman in Rise Up Xmas. Push hazards out of the way before they touch him, and keep watching where objects fall after you knock them aside.

pages.title: Christmas Klondike Solitaire
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Build suit piles from ace to king in Christmas Klondike Solitaire. Move face-up cards between columns in descending rank and alternating colors to reveal the cards underneath.

pages.title: Christmas Vehicles Hidden Keys
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Find ten hidden keys in each picture in Christmas Vehicles Hidden Keys. Click or tap where you see one before time runs out. Repeated guesses in the wrong spot cost you five seconds.

pages.title: Super Onion Boy
pages.creator: PowerSlash Studios
pages.description: Rescue a princess trapped in a magic bubble in Super Onion Boy. Use the arrows to move, Z to jump, and X to fire as you get past monsters and obstacles on the way to the boss.

pages.title: Toyota Supra Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble pictures of a Toyota Supra in Toyota Supra Puzzle. Choose from six images and four piece counts. Start with the edges or recognizable details from the car when you try the larger puzzles.

pages.title: Train Surfers
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Dodge obstacles on the tracks in Train Surfers. Use the mouse to guide the runner around hazards and watch the route ahead to keep the run going.

pages.title: Candy Monster
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Clear sweets out from under a monster in Candy Monster. Click the candies in an order that keeps the monster from hitting the ground. Think about which pieces will still support it after each move.

pages.title: Rush Hour
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Steer through four lanes of traffic in Rush Hour. Use the arrow keys to switch lanes and avoid collisions. Watch the colored lanes as well as the other cars while the road keeps moving.

pages.title: Wheelie Bike
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Hold a wheelie in Wheelie Bike. Use the mouse to lift the front wheel and make small adjustments as the bike tips. Keep your balance long enough to cover a greater distance.

pages.title: Motorbikes Jigsaw Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a motorcycle photo in Motorbikes Jigsaw Challenge and piece it back together. There are twelve images and three difficulty settings, so you can try a familiar photo with a more demanding layout.

pages.title: Car Stunt Rider
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take different cars through stunt courses in Car Stunt Rider. Use WASD to drive and line up each approach before the next obstacle. Switch cars and see how they handle across the levels.

pages.title: Independent Girls Party
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Mia and Emma celebrate Independence Day in Independent Girls Party. Pick outfits for both princesses, then use the mouse to decorate the stage for their celebration.

pages.title: Tiny Planet
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Keep moving around Tiny Planet as its route changes shape. Use the mouse to rotate and avoid hazards, looking ahead so you can adjust before the next stretch reaches you.

pages.title: Cool Tank IO Online
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Blast maze walls to reach enemy tanks in Cool Tank IO Online. Watch where you fire so you don't hit the water you're supposed to protect, and use open routes to get an angle on other players.

pages.title: Car Chase
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Use the arrow keys to steer through the pursuit in Car Chase. Change direction before a pursuing car closes in and look for a gap that gives you room to keep moving.

pages.title: Arty Mouse Sticker Book
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Make a scene with Arty Mouse and friends in Arty Mouse Sticker Book. Choose a background, drag on characters such as Scribble and Stripy, and resize or remove stickers as the picture comes together.

pages.title: Paper Monster Truck Race
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Drive a monster truck through a paper world in Paper Monster Truck Race. Clear obstacles like boxes and balls when they block the way, then collect coins to upgrade the truck. The route is untimed.

pages.title: Crazy Commando
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fight with a choice of weapons in Crazy Commando, including a rocket launcher. Move with WASD or the arrow keys and aim with the mouse. Try both modes and build up your level as you play.

pages.title: Bus with Suitcases
pages.creator: LunarPixel
pages.description: Slide luggage into complete rows in Bus with Suitcases. Think about which gaps each suitcase can fill and leave room for the next move. Use a booster when you need help keeping the board open.

pages.title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Play Rock, Paper, Scissors against the computer. Choose one of the three moves and see what the opponent picks. Rock beats scissors, scissors beat paper, and paper beats rock.

pages.title: Belle Fantasy Look
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Help the Sorting Hat place Belle in a school house in Belle Fantasy Look. Once you have the result, browse the wardrobe and put together an outfit that fits her new house.

pages.title: Ariana Inspired Hairstyles
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Try two of Ariana Grande's signature styles in Ariana Inspired Hairstyles. Start by caring for her hair, then follow the steps for a high ponytail or a half-up, half-down look.

pages.title: Super Flippy Knife
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Time your knife throws in Super Flippy Knife to hit the targets. Watch where each throw lands and adjust the next one. Earn money from your attempts and spend it on other knives.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Beauty Views
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Reassemble landscape pictures in Jigsaw Puzzle Beauty Views. Choose from sixteen scenes, including mountains, lakes, bays, and fields, then use details such as shorelines or changes in the sky to join the pieces.

pages.title: Royal Dress Designer
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Design three dresses for different events in Royal Dress Designer. Help the tailor princess choose how each dress should look and prepare the designs for the bridal competition.

pages.title: Pet Connect
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear identical pets in Pet Connect before time runs out. Select two tiles only when there's a route that can link them. Removing an outside pair can open up a path to pets farther in.

pages.title: Princesses Visit Arendelle!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get Ellie, Annie, and Aria ready to ski in Princesses Visit Arendelle! Choose winter outfits, hats, and gloves, then pick ski equipment for each princess before they head down the mountain.

pages.title: Christmas Mall Shopping
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Shop for three winter looks in Christmas Mall Shopping. Choose jackets for the princesses, then try shoes, scarves, and hats that suit each outfit and the cold weather.

pages.title: Princesses Working in the Garden
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Dress for yard work in Princesses Working in the Garden. Pick clothes and sun hats for the princesses, then help tidy the garden by gathering fallen apples and clearing leaves.

pages.title: Two Neon Boxes
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Control two neon boxes in Two Neon Boxes. Watch the obstacles approaching each box and time the jumps separately. Keep both clear of hazards as the pace picks up.
